title: Wealth And Investment Relationship Manager
description:
We are hiring on behalf of a leading and well\-established financial services organisation that is expanding its Wealth Advisory and Investment Relationship Management team across Bangalore Karnataka
 



  





 Position: Wealth \& Investment Relationship Manager
 



  





 Location: Multiple Branches Across
 



  





 This opportunity is ideal for ambitious financial\-services professionals who are passionate about investment products, client acquisition, wealth management and long\-term relationship building.
 



  





 ✅ ELIGIBILITY
 



  





 • Graduation in any discipline
 



 • Minimum 1 year of relevant experience
 



 • NISM Series V\-A certification preferred
 



 • Strong communication and client\-management skills
 



 • Working knowledge of financial and investment products
 



 • Ability to acquire clients and achieve business targets
 



  





 📊 KEY RESPONSONSIBILITIES
 



  





 • Acquire new clients through networking, referrals, appointments, lead conversion and prospecting
 



 • Understand clients’ financial goals, investment requirements and risk profiles
 



 • Present suitable financial products in line with approved research, company processes and applicable regulations
 



 • Share authorised market insights, research reports and relevant investment opportunities
 



 • Support clients across Mutual Funds, SIPs, Equity, Currency, Insurance, PMS, Bonds, IPOs and NFOs
 



 • Build and maintain trusted, long\-term client relationships
 



 • Identify suitable cross\-selling and portfolio\-development opportunities
 



 • Deliver timely after\-sales support and improve client retention
 



 • Contribute to AUM growth, revenue objectives and branch business targets
 



 • Collaborate with branch teams to follow up and convert qualified leads
 



  





 👥 WHO CAN APPLY?
 



 Professionals currently working as:
 



 • Relationship Managers
 



 • Wealth Managers
 



 • Investment Advisors
 



 • Investment Counsellors
 



 • Equity Relationship Managers
 



 • Mutual Fund Relationship Managers
 



 • Financial Consultants
 



 • Client Acquisition Managers
 



 • Branch Sales Officers
 



 • Priority Banking Relationship Managers
 



 • Personal Bankers
 



 • Insurance Relationship Managers
 



 • Demat and Trading Account Sales Executives
 



 • Investment Product Sales Professionals
 



  





 🏢 PREFERRED INDUSTRY BACKGROUNDS
 



 Candidates with relevant experience in the following industries are encouraged to apply:
 



 • Stockbroking and securities firms
 



 • Wealth\-management companies
 



 • Banks and priority\-banking divisions
 



 • Mutual fund distribution companies
 



 • Asset\-management companies
 



 • Life, health and general insurance companies
 



 • Portfolio\-management businesses
 



 • Investment\-advisory organisations
 



 • NBFCs and other financial\-services companies
 



  





 WHY APPLY?
 



 • Build a rewarding career in wealth and investment management
 



 • Gain exposure to multiple financial products
 



 • Develop premium client\-advisory and relationship\-management experience
 



 • Work with an established financial\-services organisation
 



 • Access professional learning and career\-growth opportunities
 



 • Join expanding branch teams across Kerala
 



  





 📩 HOW TO APPLY
 



  





 Interested candidates may share their updated résumé along with:
 



 • Current location
 



 • Preferred branch
 



 • Total experience
 



 • Relevant financial\-services experience
 



 • Current salary
 



 • Expected salary
 



 • Notice period
 



 • NISM certification status
